name: List all groups of a specific group type
description: List all groups of a specific group type List all groups of a specific group type. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/groups/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/groups/
List all groups of a specific group type. You must pass ?group_type_index= in the URL. To get a list of valid group types, call /api/:project_id/groups_types/. Uses forward-only keyset pagination via the `cursor` parameter. The `previous` field in the response envelope is always null.
Required: group_type_index (query) — Specify the group type to list; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: cursor (query) — Pagination cursor returned in the `next` URL of a previous response; group_key (query) — Filter groups whose key contains this string (case-insensitive); search (query) — Search the group name
